## Design roles

Each part does a job for the person. These are the jobs, as questions the part answers.

<div class="odv-am-rolelist"><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Containment</b> What holds this?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Layering</b> What sits on top?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Hierarchy</b> What do you read first?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Readability</b> Can you read it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Emphasis</b> Where does the eye go?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Meaning</b> What state is it in?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Affordance</b> Can you act on it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Feedback</b> Did it respond?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Focus</b> Where is the keyboard?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Grouping</b> What belongs together?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Reach</b> Can you hit it?</span></div>

## How the decisions reach each part

Each part follows a chain: an answer about the product, the rule it set, the token that carries it, and the value you see. The numbers match the drawing.

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-1"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox odv-am-pending">Drawn in Figma by the Open DS anatomy plugin; the image is not exported yet.</span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">1</i><b>Surface</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="What holds this?">Containment</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="What sits on top?">Layering</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Color · Which color roles does it need? → Those and brand accents</div><div class="odv-am-why">Brand accents are part of the message.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Shape · What should control corners say? → Pill</div><div class="odv-am-why">Pill controls feel playful.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Spacing · How dense is the layout? → Spacious</div><div class="odv-am-why">Big space makes big moments.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For shape of a status badge, use radius.badge (pill). Don't use a rectangle.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Pills match the controls.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.surface.inverse</code><span>→</span><code>content.background</code><span class="odv-am-val">#1F1411 · dark #FFF8F3</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">A reversed fill for small, short-lived messages.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> neutral.900: the reverse of content for short messages; its text reads, 18.0:1 on surface.inverse, above the 4.5:1 floor.</div><div><b>Dark</b> neutral.900: the reverse of content for short messages; its text reads, 17.12:1 on surface.inverse, above the 4.5:1 floor.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> text.primary. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.surface.inverse.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>radius.badge</code><span>→</span><code>content.radius</code><span class="odv-am-val">9999px</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> radius.999: Pill controls feel playful.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>component-spacing-map.x2</code><span>→</span><code>content.padding-x</code><span class="odv-am-val">0.5rem</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> space.8</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>component-spacing-map.x1</code><span>→</span><code>content.padding-y</code><span class="odv-am-val">0.25rem</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> space.4</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-2"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox odv-am-pending">Drawn in Figma by the Open DS anatomy plugin; the image is not exported yet.</span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">2</i><b>Hint</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="Can you read it?">Readability</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="What state is it in?">Meaning</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Typography · How large is body text? → Regular</div><div class="odv-am-why">Regular body; the display does the shouting.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Iconography · What do icons do? → Those and decoration</div><div class="odv-am-why">Icons also decorate campaign pages.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For an icon with no label, use Not used: always add a word. Don't use an icon button with a hover hint.</div><div class="odv-am-why">On phones, hover hints never show; a word says what will happen.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.text.inverse</code><span>→</span><code>content.label</code><span class="odv-am-val">#FFFFFF · dark #1F1411</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">Text on an inverse fill.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> text.on-dark: the text its fill's tone picks, 18.0:1 on surface.inverse, above the 4.5:1 floor.</div><div><b>Dark</b> text.on-light: the text its fill's tone picks, 17.12:1 on surface.inverse, above the 4.5:1 floor.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> text.on-action, text.on-danger. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.text.inverse.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>type.caption.font-size</code><span>→</span><code>content.font-size</code><span class="odv-am-val">0.875rem</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> font.size.14</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>type.caption.font-family</code><span>→</span><code>content.font-family</code><span class="odv-am-val">&quot;DM Sans&quot;, system-ui, sans-serif</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> dm-sans for caption text: Bricolage Grotesque for display and headings, DM Sans for text: loud where the brand speaks, easy where people read.</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

## For agents

Agents get this same anatomy: every part, its roles, whether it is required, the tokens it reads and the decisions behind them.

- **From an AI agent:** call the `get_anatomy` tool on the Open DS MCP server, with this scheme and `tooltip`.
- **From a terminal:** `npx open-ds anatomy brand-expressive tooltip`
